# Meson cross-file driving picolibc's build through zig cc.
#
# zig cc handles the riscv64-freestanding-none target end-to-end —
# preprocessor, compiler, assembler, linker — so we only need to
# point meson at it. The supporting tools (ar, ranlib, nm, strip)
# come from llvm-bintools, which our devshell already provides.
#
# Args we pin everywhere:
#   -target riscv64-freestanding-none  match the rest of the HAL
#   -mcmodel=medany                    rv64 large code model (rvvm.ld layout)
#   -ffreestanding                     no hosted assumptions
#   -fno-stack-protector               we don't have __stack_chk_guard
#   -fno-pie                           we link statically at fixed addresses
#   -nostdinc / -nostdlib              picolibc IS the libc; no prior one

[binaries]
c       = ['zig', 'cc', '-target', 'riscv64-freestanding-none']
cpp     = ['zig', 'c++', '-target', 'riscv64-freestanding-none']
ar      = 'llvm-ar'
as      = ['zig', 'cc', '-target', 'riscv64-freestanding-none']
nm      = 'llvm-nm'
strip   = 'llvm-strip'
ranlib  = 'llvm-ranlib'

[host_machine]
system     = 'none'
cpu_family = 'riscv64'
cpu        = 'riscv'
endian     = 'little'

[properties]
# picolibc tries to compile-and-link a tiny test program to sanity-
# check the toolchain; we tell it not to bother (no host runtime).
skip_sanity_check = true

# Optional layout hints picolibc uses to prefill its default linker
# script. We don't use picolibc's crt0/ld so these are advisory only,
# but match RVVM's defaults anyway.
default_flash_addr = '0x80000000'
default_flash_size = '0x10000000'
default_ram_addr   = '0x90000000'
default_ram_size   = '0x10000000'

c_args      = ['-mcmodel=medany', '-ffreestanding', '-fno-stack-protector', '-fno-pie', '-Os']
c_link_args = ['-mcmodel=medany', '-nostdlib']
